entities.name: Moussa Diabaté
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Moussa Diabaté is a French professional basketball player for the Charlotte Hornets of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines. Diabaté was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top centers in the 2021 class.
